body:
1. Fix flag/env/prompt drift across `commands/agb-plan.md`, `commands/agb-run.md`, `commands/agb-review.md`, `skills/agb-plan/SKILL.md`, `skills/agb-run/SKILL.md`, `skills/agb-review/SKILL.md`, `skills/agb-migrate/SKILL.md`, and `.agents/skills/release/SKILL.md`.
2. Update `website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs` to harvest env vars across `lib/`, `bin/`, `hooks/`, and `mcp/` and add missing entries to `website/env-docs.json`.
3. Update `README.md`, `USAGE.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `docs/guidelines.md`, `docs/execution-example.md`, and `website/content/docs/**`.
4. Run `npm run skills:sync`, `npm --prefix website run gen:reference`, and `npm run build`.
title: Sync commands & skills docs, website reference generator & env-docs, prose documentation, and rebuild dist bundles
